title: N-BEATS: Neural Basis Expansion Analysis for Interpretable Time Series Forecasting

novelty_points.claim: 提出N-BEATS，用全连接网络块和前向、后向双残差堆叠实现单变量时间序列点预测。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes N-BEATS for univariate time series point forecasting using fully connected blocks and doubly residual stacking with forward and backward outputs.
technical_features: 每个全连接网络块产生预测与回溯重构两个输出。
后续块接收前面块的残差输入，预测输出按层次聚合。
网络预测前向和后向基展开系数。
technical_features_en: Each fully connected block produces a forecast and a backcast.
Subsequent blocks receive residual inputs, while forecasts are aggregated hierarchically.
The network predicts forward and backward basis expansion coefficients.
